title: BI Lab Project Lead
description:
At Ecolab, you can help take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges, delivering critical insights and innovative solutions to help our customers achieve clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments. With our worldwide reach and ambitious growth plans, you will have the opportunity to own your future and impact what matters. Are you ready to make an impact?
   

  

**What’s In It For You**
* You will join a growth company offering a competitive salary and benefits.
* The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth.
* The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives and ideas to achieve our best.
* Feel proud each day to work for a company that provides clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments.


**Role Summary**
 The Analytics Lead is a business\-outcomes focused leader who sits at the intersection of business, analytics, and data science. This role is responsible for translating ambiguous business questions from business stakeholders into clear, actionable analytical projects. Those projects will allow your team to deliver insights that drive different and more profitable decisions across Ecolab.
   

  

 This individual will work iteratively with a variety of stakeholders across the enterprise. The day\-to\-day may include rapidly prototyping, refining solutions with stakeholders, and ultimately identifying which solutions should be scaled. As solutions mature, they will partner with BI developers and data engineers to operationalize them.
   

  

 Success in this role is defined not by technical complexity, but by the ability to deliver relevant, impactful, and scalable data solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into data\-driven solutions
+ Engage stakeholders to understand goals, context, and constraints
+ Identify the most relevant questions, metrics, and drivers of value


* Rapidly prototype insights and analytical tools
+ Move quickly from problem definition to gathering data to delivering an insight.
+ Deliver early versions of analyses, dashboards, models, or lightweight tools.
+ Iterate based on feedback to refine solutions.

* Apply the appropriate analytical approach
+ Work with stakeholders to determine when to use visualization, statistical analysis, modeling, or simple heuristics to a business problem.
+ Balance speed, rigor, and usability based on the situation (including the maturity of the question and the needs of the business).

* Perform data transformation and analysis
+ Use SQL or Python to source, clean, and transform data into useable data for analysis. If engaged in scaling data transformation, leverage Databricks or Python to create a scaled and tested data model for consumption.

* Design meaningful metrics and outputs
+ Define metrics that align with real business outcomes. Work with stakeholders to understand gaps in metric definitions or propose functional alternatives.
+ Ensure outputs are interpretable and relevant to business needs.

* Evolve prototypes into scalable solutions
+ Translate prototypes into clear requirements for BI developers and data engineers
+ Partner cross\-functionally to scale solutions into production

* Operate flexibly between guiding team and execution
+ Provide direction and oversight when resources allow
+ Contribute hands\-on development when needed in resource\-constrained environments

* Drive insight\-led decision\-making
+ Use outputs to guide and advance stakeholder conversations
+ Continuously refine questions and approaches through iteration


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data science
* Experience working directly with stakeholders and iterating on analytical outputs
* Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into analytical approaches and solutions
* Strong problem\-framing and prioritization skills, with a focus on business impact
* Strong proficiency in SQL and Python


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Databricks or Python for data transformation and modeling
* Experience building lightweight applications or prototypes using Python.
* Experience with AI\-enabled analytics tools such as Snowflake Cortex Agent or Databricks Genie.
* Experience implementing or supporting data quality testing frameworks.
* Exposure to product\-oriented thinking in analytics (e.g., scaling dashboards, tools, or data products)
* Ability to translate exploratory work into structured requirements for engineering teams
* Experience using Claude Code or similar GenAI development tools.


**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

title: Talent Manager - Government & Policy Partnerships
description:
**About The Role**
 Madhouse Mafia is looking for a proactive Talent Manager to work closely with CA Palak Rathi on government and policy\-led campaigns. The candidate will be employed by Madhouse Mafia, report directly to the agency's founder, and lead outreach to government departments, policymakers, public\-sector bodies, and other relevant stakeholders.
   

  

 The role involves identifying government and public\-policy opportunities, building institutional relationships, and managing campaigns from initial outreach through execution. The ideal candidate is confident in outreach, persistent with follow\-ups, comfortable representing both the talent and agency in formal conversations, and capable of independently driving opportunities forward.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Work closely with CA Palak Rathi and Madhouse Mafia to identify suitable government and policy\-led campaign opportunities
* Proactively reach out to government officials, policymakers, departments, ministries, agencies, public\-sector bodies, and liaison offices
* Build and maintain a structured database of government contacts, conversations, opportunities, and follow\-ups
* Source government campaigns, public\-awareness initiatives, policy\-led projects, institutional partnerships, and relevant events
* Develop relationships with government and policy stakeholders and keep engagement active between campaigns
* Coordinate opportunities end to end, including introductions, proposals, meetings, negotiations, documentation, approvals, and execution
* Represent CA Palak Rathi and Madhouse Mafia professionally in calls, meetings, emails, and official correspondence
* Coordinate with internal and external teams to ensure campaign requirements, timelines, approvals, and deliverables are met
* Manage scheduling, communication, and day\-to\-day talent coordination when required
* Track outreach activity and provide regular updates on leads, progress, outcomes, and campaign status


**Requirements**
* 2\-5 years of experience in government liaison, public affairs, public policy, advocacy, PR, talent management, partnerships, or campaign coordination
* Prior experience working on government, public\-policy, advocacy, or policy\-led talent campaigns is strongly preferred
* Familiarity with government departments, policymaking stakeholders, and public\-sector working processes
* An existing network of government or policy contacts is a strong advantage
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi
* Confidence in cold outreach, relationship\-building, negotiation, and consistent follow\-up
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and operate without daily supervision
* Strong organization, documentation, and stakeholder\-management skills
* Professional judgment and discretion when representing the talent and agency
* Willingness to travel for meetings and campaign work when required


**Preferred Profile**
* A self\-driven professional with strong government\-facing communication skills
* Someone who understands how to approach government and policy stakeholders professionally
* A relationship builder who can convert outreach into meaningful campaign opportunities
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving agency environment and coordinating across multiple stakeholders

description:
At Thomson Reuters, our technology drives global markets and helps professionals around the world make decisions that matter. As the world's leading provider of intelligent information, we want your unique perspective to create the solutions that advance our business and your career.
   

  

**About The Role**
**In this opportunity as a Senior Endpoints Engineer, you will:**
 As a Senior Engineer Focused On JAMF Pro And JAMF Connect At Thomson Reuters, You Will Drive How The Mac Platform Is Architected, Rolled Out, Operated, And Supported. The Work Spans
   

  

* End\-to\-end JAMF leadership: Leading JAMF Pro and JAMF Connect implementations from design through rollout to BAU, including pilot\-to\-global migration programs and controlled change.
* Mac authentication architecture: Defining and implementing Mac authentication strategy — Platform SSO, SSO, MFA, and identity integration with Entra ID or Okta.
* Enrollment, lifecycle, and automation: Designing enrollment workflows (ADE and re\-enrollment), configuration profiles, compliance policies, patching, and self\-service capabilities across the macOS fleet.
* Senior technical support: Acting as L3 escalation for complex macOS issues; developing support artifacts and coaching L1/L2 engineers and the HCL service desk partner to sustain BAU quality.
* Security and IAM partnership: Driving macOS endpoint hardening (FileVault, Gatekeeper, CIS benchmarks) and partnering with Security and IAM on conditional access and identity integration.
* ServiceNow and Service Desk integration: Building workflows between JAMF Pro and ServiceNow for request fulfilment and incident routing; contributing to Now Assist workflows for macOS.


**About You**
 You're a fit for the role of Senior Engineer if you have the following required qualifications.
   

  

* 6–10 years in endpoint engineering, with strong hands\-on experience in JAMF Pro and JAMF Connect — non\-negotiable.
* Advanced macOS enterprise management: MDM enrollment, configuration profiles, PPPC, kernel and system extension policies.
* Deep troubleshooting expertise, including L3 escalation for complex macOS issues across performance, identity, compliance, and platform behavior.
* Identity integration with Entra ID (Azure AD) or Okta — SSO, MFA, conditional access.
* Strong scripting and API experience — Bash, Python, or Swift for automation and remediation; hands\-on with the JAMF Pro API for integrations and reporting.
* Proven delivery track record at scale — pilot\-to\-global rollouts and migration program execution.
* Strong communication and coaching skills for working across IT, Security, IAM, and L1/L2 support partners.
* Experience integrating Intune and JAMF in cross\-platform endpoint estates.
* Hands\-on experience with Platform SSO (PSSO) and password less authentication on macOS.
* Exposure to Nexthink for remote actions and endpoint analytics on macOS.
* Experience operating in regulated or compliance\-driven environments.
* Relevant certifications — JAMF 200/300/400 or Apple Certified IT Professional.


**What’s in it For You?**
* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2\-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company\-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award\-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work\-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro\-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real\-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


**About Us**
 Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
   

  

 We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
   

  

 As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug\-free workplace.
   

  

 We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.
   

  

 Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.
   

  

 More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com.

As a strategic pillar of the media team, the Search Lead will manage performance\-based responsibilities to ensure that digital marketing efforts translate directly into measurable growth and enrollment for our global clientele.
   

  

**The Role**
 This role reports directly to the Client Lead for the EdTech account, with a matrix reporting line to the Global Client Lead. Success in this position requires close collaboration with the Global Search Lead to align local execution with global standards. Additionally, you will supervise and guide 2\-3 team members in a matrix structure, fostering a culture of performance and continuous optimization.

* Strong commitment to learning new ways of working and integrating cutting\-edge AI technologies into daily operations.


**Preferred**

 We are looking for a motivated
 
**SEO Executive**

**AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)** 

 and
 
**GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)** 

 .
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**SEO Optimization** 



* Perform keyword research for service pages, blogs, landing pages, and other website content.
* Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, and image alt text.

* Assist with internal linking and website content structure.
* Monitor keyword rankings and organic traffic.
* Support basic off\-page SEO and link\-building activities.

**Technical SEO** 



* Perform basic website SEO audits.
* Check website crawling and indexing issues.
* Review XML sitemaps and robots.txt.
* Monitor pages through Google Search Console.
* Identify basic Core Web Vitals and page\-speed issues.
* Check canonical tags, redirects, status codes, and page indexing.

**Content Optimization** 



* Optimize blogs and service pages based on target keywords and search intent.
* Recommend improvements to headings, FAQs, content structure, and internal linking.

* Review published content for basic SEO best practices.

**AEO – Answer Engine Optimization** 



* Researching question\-based search queries.
* Creating and optimizing FAQ sections.
* Structuring content with clear questions and direct answers.
* Improving content for featured snippets and People Also Ask results.
* Helping implement appropriate structured data/schema recommendations.
* Creating concise answer\-focused sections within service pages and blogs.
* Improving topical relevance and content clarity.



**GEO – Generative Engine Optimization** 



* Researching how brands and competitors appear across AI search platforms.
* Checking brand mentions and citations on platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI search experiences.
* Identifying content that can improve brand authority and AI\-search discoverability.
* Helping optimize statistics, FAQs, definitions, comparisons, expert insights, and factual content.
* Finding relevant third\-party websites where brand mentions or citations can be developed.
* Supporting content optimization for better entity and topical authority.
* Monitoring changes in AI search visibility.



**SEO Tools** 





 The candidate should have basic working knowledge of some of the following tools:
 



* Google Search Console
* Google Analytics / GA4
* Google Keyword Planner
* Google Trends
* Ahrefs / Semrush / Ubersuggest or similar SEO tools
* PageSpeed Insights
* Screaming Frog or similar crawling tools
* ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or other AI tools



**Required Skills** 



* Good understanding of basic SEO concepts.
* Basic knowledge of on\-page and off\-page SEO.
* Understanding of keyword research and search intent.
* Ability to analyze Google search results and competitors.
* Basic understanding of technical SEO.
* Good research skills.
* Basic understanding of content optimization.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets and SEO reports.
* Basic understanding of AI tools and AI\-powered search.
* Willingness to learn AEO, GEO, structured data, and modern SEO techniques.
* Good written communication skills.



**Key Performance Areas** 



* Improvement in keyword visibility
* Growth in organic impressions and clicks

* SEO issues identified and resolved
* Improvement of existing website content
* Growth of relevant indexed pages
* Quality of keyword and competitor research

description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 We are looking for a detail\-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands\-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.
   

  

 As an Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers, prepare SOP’s with new processes, stake holder management with cross functional teams. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 🔷 Rack Installation \& Cabling
   

  

* Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
* Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
* Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self\-resolving outside approved procedures
* Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities


 🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations
   

  

* Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
* Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as\-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
* Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self\-resolve outside approved procedures
* Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre\-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation


 🔷 Material Handling \& Supply Chain Support
   

  

* Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
* Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
* Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines


 🔷 Handover \& Documentation
   

  

* Complete all required as\-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign\-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
* Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
* Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase


 🔷 Rack Decommissioning
   

  

* Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de\-tagging, and rack extraction
* Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
* Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
* Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post\-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
* Validate that reclaimed U\-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool


 🔷 Quality, Safety \& Compliance
   

  

* Adhere to all site\-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
* Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
* Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity


 🔷 Cross\-Team Coordination

 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de\-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. **Job Description**
***Executive \- Transport***
***This role is responsible for responsible for overseeing daily transportation operations, ensuring smooth coordination of staff and vehicle movement. The role involves managing vendor relationships, route planning, cost optimization, adherence to compliance and safety standards, and addressing employee transport requirements. Also handle MIS reporting, monitor service quality, resolve escalations, and support in implementing process improvements for efficient and safe transport services.***
***Service Delivery***
* Deliver high\-quality, prompt, and courteous transport management services.
* Ensure smooth daily transport operations while maintaining service standards.
* Attend to emergencies, including medical transport needs, ensuring minimal disruption.


***Coordination \& Communication***
* Liaise daily with the Customer’s Transport Manager on operational matters.
* Escalate all issues beyond delegated authority to the Transport Manager.
* Coordinate with vendor operations teams to ensure timely employee pickups and drops.
* Attend and respond to employee calls regarding day\-to\-day transport issues.
* Communicate any SOP changes or process updates to the Transport Manager.


***Fleet \& Vendor Management***
* Monitor and control fleet deployment by vendors (drivers and vehicles).
* Ensure compliance with safety and quality norms before dispatch (seat belts, first\-aid kit, fire extinguisher, communication system, and driver readiness).
* Validate cab\-in times and cross\-check with cab requests.
* Coordinate vehicle maintenance and servicing schedules.
* Ensure vendor adherence to operational standards and office decorum.
* Report all vendor non\-compliance or process deviations to the Transport Manager.


***Operational Planning***
* Prepare and ensure availability of transport rosters before dispatch.
* Incorporate all deviations before dispatch and document last\-minute changes.
* Plan and coordinate driver schedules and shifts.
* Optimize route planning to reduce operational costs and improve efficiency.
* Utilize GPS or Transport Management Systems (TMS) for real\-time tracking.


***Compliance \& Safety***
* Ensure adherence to transport safety norms and legal regulations.
* Maintain proper documentation for audits, inspections, and compliance checks.
* Investigate transport incidents and report findings with corrective actions.
* Track fuel consumption, mileage, and vehicle usage to prevent misuse.


***Reporting \& Analysis***
* Ensure timely release of daily MIS reports by the vendor.
* Analyze transport data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement areas.
* Prepare and submit periodic performance and compliance reports to management.


***Automation \& IT Enablement***
* Implement and manage automation tools for transport tracking, attendance, and billing.
* Support GPS tracking systems, route optimization software, and mobile\-based trip management.
* Develop Excel macros, formulas, or simple scripts to automate repetitive tasks.
* Coordinate with IT teams/vendors for system integration and troubleshooting.


***Issue \& Grievance Handling***
* Address and resolve transport\-related employee complaints.
* Handle grievances and disputes with drivers and vendors effectively.
* 4\-5\+ years’ experience in transportation
* Good knowledge of route planning, vendor management, and fleet coordination.
* Understanding of transport compliance, safety norms, and statutory requirements.
* Strong coordination, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Advanced MS Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, Macros)
* Power BI / Tableau (preferred)
* Basic knowledge of databases, SQL, or scripting (added advantage)
* Proficiency in transport management software for MIS \& reporting.
* Ability to handle escalations and ensure timely resolutions.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple stakeholders.
* Flexibility to work in shifts/extended hours as per business needs.
* Knowledge of local geography and traffic regulations.

title: Design Manager – Mechanical (Water & Wastewater Infrastructure)
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 As a Design Manager – Mechanical Infrastructure, you will lead the multidisciplinary mechanical design delivery for complex water and wastewater infrastructure projects, including pump stations, water treatment plants (WTPs), wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs), desalination systems, and associated mechanical/process systems.
   

  

 You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, quality assurance, constructability, risk management, and programme certainty across all stages of project delivery—from concept through detailed and construction design.
   

  

 Working closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional Leadership, you will plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of mechanical design packages, while mentoring and developing engineers across global teams.
   

  

 Key duties include
   

  

* Lead and manage mechanical design for water/wastewater pump stations, treatment plants, and associated mechanical/process systems.
* Develop project\-specific mechanical design strategies ensuring multidisciplinary integration, alignment with project requirements, and risk mitigation.
* Oversee preparation and coordination of mechanical deliverables
+ Equipment sizing \& selection
+ Mechanical design calculations
+ Pumping system calculations \& hydraulic checks
+ P\&IDs, equipment layouts, plant general arrangements
+ Mechanical data sheets and specifications

* Review and validate vendor documents, datasheets, and shop drawings; ensure integration with overall design.
* Lead mechanical engineering inputs for Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) and EPC delivery models constructability, staging, installation methodology, O\&M requirements.
* Support and lead HAZOP/HAZID, value engineering, risk workshops, failure mode assessments, and operability/maintainability reviews.
* Manage and own key design management documents
+ Project Responsibility Matrix
+ Basis of Design
+ Overall Design Programme
+ Schedule of Deliverables
+ Design Risk Register
+ Design Change Register

* Coordinate with process, civil, electrical, ICA, BIM, structural, and architectural teams for holistic design delivery.
* Engage with clients through workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical clarifications.
* Ensure design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, project specifications, and HSE requirements.
* Support the preparation of technical proposals, LOE estimates, design execution plans, and project scheduling.
* Mentor, coach, and provide performance feedback to engineers to strengthen organisational capability.
* Collaborate with global delivery centres to ensure consistent design practices and effective resource utilisation.


**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
 **delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects** 
 .**
 Here's what you'll need
   

  

**Key software tools**
* PipeFlo, AFT Fathom/Impulse, WaterGEMS (for hydraulics interface), vendor pump selection software
* Planning \& Coordination Primavera P6, MS Project
* Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
* BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Plant 3D, OpenPlant Modeler, Navisworks, Revizto


**Key Behaviours**
* Builds strong, collaborative relationships across multidisciplinary teams.
* Confident, approachable leader with strong client‑facing presence.
* Demonstrates leadership through coordination, clarity, and proactive communication.
* Encourages teams to develop integrated, constructible, and high‑quality mechanical design solutions.
* Organised, disciplined, and able to resolve complex mechanical issues in a timely manner.
* Champions a strong culture of safety, quality, and innovation.
* Flexible, dependable, and capable of performing in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments.


**Work Experience**
* 15\+ years of experience in mechanical engineering design and design management within water/wastewater infrastructure projects.


* Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams delivering mechanical design for
+ Water/wastewater pump stations
+ WTPs/WWTPs and associated process units
+ Chemical dosing systems
+ Sludge handling systems
+ High‑lift/low‑lift pumping systems
+ Treatment mechanical equipment (screens, clarifiers, blowers, compressors, valves, etc.)

* Strong understanding of pumping systems NPSH, system curves, pump selection, surge analysis interface, pipework design, and hydraulic analysis.
* Demonstrated capability in Design for Design‑Build constructability reviews, contractor interface, installation sequencing, technical risk mitigation.
* Experience coordinating mechanical design within a BIM‑enabled environment.
* Strong ability to interpret P\&IDs, hydraulic profiles, process input documents, engineering drawings, and specifications.
* Experience with vendor coordination, MTO/BoQ preparation, equipment procurement support, and technical bid evaluations.
* Experience with change management, design risk management, and impacts assessment.
* Ability to support bids, proposals, LOE estimates, and multidisciplinary design execution plans.
* Experience with alternate delivery models (DB, EPC, CMAR, PPP) is an asset.
* Strong interest in digital delivery, automation, and continuous improvement of mechanical workflows.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in relevant field is advantageous
* Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Mechanical Engineer (CEng) is advantageous


**Preferred Attributes**
* Experience delivering large, complex water/wastewater facilities and pumping systems.
* Exposure to brownfield upgrades, shutdown/staging, and commissioning planning.
* Knowledge of sustainability principles and low‑carbon mechanical design approaches.
* Experience working with international codes, standards, and global delivery frameworks.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments


**Hybrid Work Expectation**

title: Associate Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
The Associate \- Accounts Receivable is responsible for the Order\-to\-Cash activities of its Business Lines covering billing, collections, cash application, and revenue recognition and reporting — ensuring accuracy, timely recovery of receivables, and clear visibility of customer outstanding balances for the business.
   

  

 The role brings standardisation to customer\-level visibility of revenue, invoicing and outstanding balances, and holds ownership of collections performance for an assigned customer portfolio, including ageing, DSO and overdue exposure. It requires a sound understanding of the business and its revenue drivers, the ability to manage large data sets and present up\-to\-date insights, control over pricing in the revenue systems, and effective partnering with Sales and Account Management on outstanding invoices, billing queries and customer escalations.
   

  

**Requirements**
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
   

  

* Maintain up\-to\-date, detailed pricing data to support invoicing and revenue management
* Apply control checks on invoicing data across all revenue streams
* Participate in the end\-to\-end Accounts Receivable process, from invoice generation through to collection and cash application
* Prepare, review and issue customer invoices accurately and on schedule, ensuring supporting data, tariffs and contractual terms are correctly applied before dispatch, and resolving discrepancies prior to release
* Manage collections for an assigned customer portfolio: monitor ageing reports, follow up on overdue invoices through structured dunning, and escalate long\-outstanding or high\-risk accounts in line with the agreed escalation matrix
* Issue statements of account and payment reminders, and record committed payment dates and collection notes to maintain a reliable receivables and cash\-inflow forecast
* Perform cash application on a daily basis, allocating incoming receipts to the correct customer invoices and matching remittance advices accurately
* Interact with Sales and Account Management on outstanding invoices — sharing overdue positions, obtaining customer feedback, resolving billing queries and disputes, and jointly agreeing recovery actions on ageing accounts
* Coordinate and assist in year\-end finalisation and audits, providing AR schedules and supporting documentation


**Requirements**
 Minimum Education/Qualification: Bachelor of Commerce (CMA, CA, B. Com or BBA); accounting certifications an advantage.
   

  

 Min. Experience :
   

  

* 4\+ years' experience in accounts receivable, billing or order\-to\-cash
* Direct communication with customers on billing and collections matters


 Industry
   

  

* 
* Order\-to\-cash, billing, collections or revenue accounting environment
* 
* Maritime technology, shipping services or a transaction\-based business preferred


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Hands\-on experience across the end\-to\-end order\-to\-cash cycle: billing, collections and cash application
* ERP experience (NetSuite or equivalent), including the AR and billing modules
* Maintenance of pricing and tariff data in revenue systems, including approval controls
* Control over credit notes and amendments to issued invoices
* Cash application, remittance matching and clearing of unapplied, unidentified or short\-paid receipts
* Statements of account, structured dunning and escalation processes
* Revenue reconciliation between invoicing and operational data
* Monthly revenue reporting, budget deviation analysis and forecasting models
* Analytics and data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI) for AR, billing and revenue reporting
* Advanced Excel, with the ability to manage and interpret large data sets


 Languages : English (fluent)

title: Transfer Pricing Manager, Mumbai
description:
**Transfer Pricing Manager – Siemens Ltd.**
 We’re looking for dedicated team player with the skills and vision to build a better tomorrow. Join our Tax team as a Tax Manager and ensure compliance with TP regulations. Also help us build the technology that will transform entire industries, cities and even countries.
   

  

 The position exists as a support function to the Tax department to fulfil statutory obligations applicable to the company.
   

  

**Change the future with us!**
* Assistance in preparation and filing of Return of Income, tax audit and transfer pricing (Form 3CEB) requirements as per statutory deadlines.
* Undertaking all TP compliances (including BEPS related Master file, CBC, etc.) and filing of tax and TP returns of foreign affiliates.
* Preparing TP documentation to support intra\-group transactions in compliance with local regulations.
* Supporting audits, respond to the assessment notices, prepare appeals and submissions, attending hearings before the tax authorities.
* Advice on TP implications of new business initiatives. Advise on TP queries received from business, interpret various tax treaties, MLI, etc.
* Conducting regular review of TP policies in accordance with the latest tax regulations and developments. To ensure that all actions for preparation and filing of TP returns, assessment notices, etc. are handled in time so that exposure of TP adjustment and litigations can be minimized if not eliminated completely.
* Oversight on the company's transfer pricing matters and partnering with multiple stakeholders to provide support on transfer pricing related issues, including industry standards mandated by SEBI LODR.
* You will be involved in Tax Assessments: Review notices, prepare submissions and attend/ organize representation at assessment hearings, provide information as required during the course of assessment proceedings. This may involve coordination with various corporate functions, business steams, external consultants etc.
* Appeals: Draft appeals, attend/organize representation at proceedings conducted by DRP / Commissioner of Income\-tax and Income Tax Appellate Tribunal as required. Briefing the counsel / lawyer, attending hearings before the ITAT, taking adjournments, etc.
* You will be responsible for post assessment activities like getting OGEs, stay of demand, follow up for obtaining refunds, obtaining rectification orders, etc. so that company gets the orders/ refunds as fast as possible.
* Knowledge Management: Keeping abreast of change of laws/ any tribunal/high court decisions so that relevant information is passed on within the team and to the business divisions, so that timely and accurate decisions are taken, and compliance of tax is ensured.
* Assist in various Automation / Digitalization projects.


**You Will Be Working With**
**External \-** 
 Tax authorities, Senior counsels and advocates, External Auditors, Consultants
   

  

**Internal:** 
 Commercials / BA, Technical team, Marketing/ Sales group commercials, Works, CF, Accounts, Personnel, HR, Internal Audit and other Divisions Group companies both domestic and international.
   

  

**We don’t need superheroes, just super minds**
* You are a Qualified CA and you bring 5 to 7 years of experience in transfer pricing area with knowledge of Income Tax Act, DTAA, FEMA and recent case laws etc. Knowledge of Accounting and Finance and Indian GAAP, USGAAP/IFRS, Commercial concepts, Business understanding.
* Conversant with MS office is must. Knowledge of search database, ERP tool such as SAP, ESPIRIT will be an added advantage.
* You should have strong analytical skills and a high attention to detail.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with different partners.


**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens!**
 This role is based in Mumbai (Worli). You’ll also get to visit other locations in India and beyond, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries \- and the craft of things to come.
   

  

 We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.
   

  

**Find out more about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers**

 Troubleshooting product configuration to resolve or provide optimal product configuration to meet customer business requirements.
   

  

 Clearly and effectively communicating responses and value to customers.

 Reviewing customer tenants to identify adoption opportunities (Feature Adoption Tenant Reviews).
   

  

 Completing and maintaining product expertise and Workday Certification(s) along with familiarity with Workday roadmap.
   

  

 Keeping up to date with industry practices and the ability to engage with our customers on those topics.
   

  

 Helping drive the creation of new programs to drive customer feature adoption
   

  

 In addition to delivering Workday Success Plans services, our Workday professionals will also deliver other services such as:
   

  

 Perform configuration and business requirements reviews with a detailed deliverable calling out opportunities for optimization
   

  

 Provide one\-on\-one customer configuration designs
   

  

 Deployments including full deployment of Workday features
   

  

**About You**
 2\+ years of experience with Workday Adaptive Planning implementations
   

  

 5 years of IT implementation experience
   

  

 3\+ years of software consulting experience
   

  

**Additional Qualifications:**
 1\+ years experience in Adaptive Integrations with external systems
   

  

 Workday Adaptive Planning Certification is a huge plus

 Ability to gain a thorough understanding of Workday concepts as new features are released
   

  

 Ability to distill complex concepts into understandable presentations for our customers
   

  

 Ability to multitask and work on multiple engagements and deliverables simultaneously
   

  

 Strong critical thinking skills so as to understand complex, technical process issues and facilitate/influence decision making
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience required. Advanced degree preferred.

**Job Title**

**Division**

These include world\-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high\-end design capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets.
   

  

**Summary Section**
 The Quality Inspector – Equipment role is a senior quality assurance position responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications throughout the manufacturing and inspection lifecycle of static process equipment, including pressure vessels, heat exchangers, rotating equipment, and associated systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide technical guidance on quality, welding, and NDE requirements for process equipment.
* Review vendor technical proposals to ensure compliance with project and quality requirements.
* Lead supplier qualification assessments, audits, and evaluations.
* Conduct pre\-inspection meetings with suppliers and stakeholders.
* Review and approve quality documents, including ITPs, welding procedures, weld records, PWHT procedures, NDE procedures, and testing documentation.
* Perform and oversee shop inspections in accordance with approved Inspection \& Test Plans (ITPs).

description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***








**Who We Are…**





 When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the

**General Summary:**









 The purpose of this role is to plan and prepare the daily presentation schedule for assigned networks in conjunction, and coordinating, with the Programming, On Air Promotion, Sales, Media Planning and Transmission departments, ensuring accuracy, completeness, compliance, and delivery according to the prescribed deadlines.  The schedulers form part of a team working directly under the Broadcast Schedule Operations Supervisor.
 




  


**Key Responsibilities:**







* Creation and finalization of the daily transmission schedule, ensuring accuracy and efficiency whilst remaining reactive to the business.
* Create compliant and optimized traffic schedules in WBD Sales System for assigned channels and manage the accurate export to scheduling system
* The planning and scheduling of Live events and Sports broadcasts across the assigned channel portfolio and territories, liaising with key stakeholders across internal and external platforms to deliver the highest levels of live playout.
* Liaising with the Media Planner to ensure smooth hand over of prepped schedules ready for promo placement.
* Identify issues and work with relevant departments to find solutions ensuring all elements air successfully and fulfill regional regulatory requirements.
* To fully understand break patterns and templates and ensure they are checked and loaded into the system and that all final commercial loads or amendments are actioned.
* Organization and regular revision of presentation templates.
* Liaise with the Media Asset Management team and Regional Sales teams checking all media items are present or accounted for prior to download of schedules to transmission.
* Perform necessary checks to the presentation schedule.
* Liaise with Transmission teams, confirming correct playlist versions have been received and necessary changes to ‘on\-air’ have taken place.


* Perform daily presentation schedule reconciliation in both Scheduling and Sales systems and provide any reports, including discrepancy reports as required by the Supervisor/Manager.


* Attending meetings and building strong relationships with key contacts in the WBD internal and regional offices.
* Cross training to develop knowledge across feeds and regions within the department.
* Any other presentation scheduling tasks required and assigned by the Supervisor that are appropriate and in line with the position.







  


**Requirements:**







* Coordinators will ideally have two or more years’ experience in a presentation/promotion scheduling, traffic or a related role.  However, candidates with an exceptional attitude may also be considered with less experience, to take on in an entry level position.
* Computer literate with prior experience working with Broadcast management and/or Sales systems such as IBMS, BTS, Media Genix.
* Communication skills are a must.
* Great attention to detail and able to work to deadlines efficiently even in pressurized situations.
* Ability to work with others and to follow instructions.
* Operational experience and/or Language skills are an advantage.







  


**Metrics:**



* Delivery of the daily transmission schedules within deadlines and high levels of accuracy.
* To be able to independently resolve basic scheduling issues and commercial load errors.
* To have a broad understanding of the regional aspects of the feed and Channel priorities
* Successfully working with others in the organization as part of the team to ensure all schedules are delivered in a timely manner.
* Working with other departments to ensure all matters relating to the creation of the daily presentation schedule and associated work processes are followed and any issues fed back as required.
* To become proficient in the presentation scheduling functions across numerous channels where required.



















  


**How We Get Things Done…**









 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at
 

















 www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/
 

















 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
 








**Championing Inclusion at WBD**



 Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

title: Facilities Executive
description:
Facility Executive\- IFM operations
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The Executive is responsible for coordinating and managing integrated facility services operations encompassing both soft services (housekeeping,technical security, reception, catering) and technical services coordination (basic maintenance, vendor liaison, work order management). This role maintains robust governance frameworks to ensure service quality, compliance, and performance excellence across all facility operations. The position requires strong coordination skills, technical awareness, attention to detail, governance capabilities, and a customer service orientation to maintain high service standards, operational efficiency, and occupant satisfaction.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Soft Services Coordination**
 Coordinate daily operations of housekeeping, janitorial, and cleaning services across the facility. Oversee reception, front\-of\-house services, and visitor management operations. Manage mail room operations including courier services, package handling, and distribution. Coordinate catering services, pantry management, and kitchen/breakroom upkeep. Monitor landscaping, pest control, and waste management services. Ensure proper functioning of employee amenities including meeting rooms, breakout areas, and common spaces. Conduct regular walkthroughs and inspections to ensure service quality and cleanliness standards are met.
   

  

**Technical Services Coordination**
 Coordinate routine maintenance activities for building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and lighting. Manage work order systems for technical service requests and maintenance issues. Liaise with technical vendors and contractors for repairs, preventive maintenance, and servicing. Monitor completion of scheduled preventive maintenance tasks and inspections. Track maintenance schedules for critical building equipment and systems. Coordinate access for technical contractors and ensure proper site induction procedures. Log and track technical issues, service calls, and resolution timelines. Escalate urgent technical matters to Facility Manager or engineering team. Support energy management initiatives by reporting anomalies in consumption or system performance. Assist with coordination of minor building projects and equipment installations.
   

  

**Governance Framework \& Standards**
 Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all soft and technical services activities. Create and implement service delivery standards, quality benchmarks, and performance criteria. Establish inspection protocols, checklists, and quality assurance processes for both service categories. Document workflows, service schedules, and operational guidelines. Maintain governance documentation including policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure alignment with organizational standards and industry best practices. Review and update governance documents regularly to reflect operational changes and improvements. Create technical service protocols including emergency response procedures and escalation matrices.
   

  

**Performance Monitoring \& Reporting**
 Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for all facility services operations. Implement service level monitoring systems and maintain performance dashboards. Conduct regular audits and inspections using standardized assessment criteria. Generate daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports for management review. Analyze service delivery trends, identify patterns, and highlight areas requiring attention. Maintain performance scorecards for vendors and internal service teams. Track technical service metrics including response times, first\-time fix rates, and equipment uptime. Monitor compliance with preventive maintenance schedules and service intervals. Present findings and recommendations to facility management and stakeholders. Generate equipment performance reports and maintenance history logs.
   

  

**Vendor \& Contractor Management**
 Serve as primary point of contact for soft services and technical services vendors and contractors. Monitor vendor performance against defined SLAs and contractual obligations. Coordinate service requests and communicate requirements to service providers. Track vendor attendance, timesheets, and service delivery documentation. Conduct regular vendor performance reviews and feedback sessions. Report vendor performance issues and coordinate corrective actions. Assist with vendor onboarding and orientation to facility requirements. Maintain vendor compliance records including insurance certificates, licenses, certifications, and trade qualifications. Manage vendor escalations and dispute resolution processes. Coordinate technical certifications and equipment\-specific training requirements for contractors.
   

  

**Service Quality \& Compliance Management**
 Implement and monitor service level standards for all facility services. Conduct quality inspections and maintain inspection checklists and reports. Address service deficiencies promptly and follow up on corrective actions. Respond to occupant requests, complaints, and feedback regarding facility services. Maintain high standards of cleanliness, presentation, and service delivery. Verify technical work completion and quality before sign\-off. Implement continuous improvement initiatives based on feedback and observations. Ensure adherence to organizational policies, procedures, and governance requirements. Monitor compliance with service contracts and specifications. Verify compliance with technical standards, building codes, and manufacturer specifications.
   

  

**Documentation \& Records Management**
 Maintain comprehensive facility services records, logs, and documentation systems. Process work orders and service requests through facility management systems (CMMS/CAFM). Document service incidents, non\-conformances, and corrective actions taken. Track consumables inventory including cleaning supplies, pantry items, and amenities. Maintain equipment registers, asset lists, and technical specifications. Document maintenance history, service records, and warranty information. Maintain audit trails for inspections, quality checks, and service delivery. Coordinate supplies ordering and ensure adequate stock levels. Prepare regular reports on service delivery, incidents, and performance metrics. Maintain vendor contracts, insurance certificates, and compliance documentation. Archive historical records and ensure data integrity and accessibility. Maintain technical drawings, equipment manuals, and as\-built documentation.
   

  

**Budget \& Financial Governance**
 Support budget tracking and invoice processing for facility services. Monitor expenditure against approved budgets and highlight variances. Review vendor invoices for accuracy and compliance with contracted rates. Track cost trends and identify opportunities for efficiency improvements. Maintain financial records and support audit processes. Assist in budget preparation and forecasting for facility services. Monitor technical service costs including emergency call\-outs and breakdown repairs. Ensure proper financial controls and approval processes are followed. Identify cost\-saving opportunities through preventive maintenance and service optimization.
   

  

**Health, Safety \& Regulatory Compliance**
 Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations for all facility services activities. Monitor proper use of cleaning chemicals, equipment, and safety procedures. Oversee contractor safety compliance including permits to work and risk assessments. Conduct safety briefings with service providers and maintain safety records. Report safety incidents, near misses, and hazards promptly. Maintain incident logs and investigation documentation. Support emergency preparedness including evacuation procedures and crisis response. Ensure proper waste segregation, recycling programs, and environmental compliance. Monitor regulatory requirements for technical systems including fire safety, lifts, and pressure systems. Conduct risk assessments for facility services operations. Verify contractor licensing and certification compliance for technical trades. Maintain records of statutory inspections and compliance certifications.
   

  

**Work Order \& Request Management**
 Manage facility management system (CMMS) for tracking all service requests and work orders. Prioritize incoming requests based on urgency and impact. Assign work orders to appropriate vendors or internal teams. Monitor work order status and follow up on pending items. Communicate progress updates to requestors and stakeholders. Close completed work orders with proper documentation and verification. Generate work order reports and analyze trends in service requests. Identify recurring issues requiring permanent solutions. Maintain response time metrics and service level compliance. Coordinate planned versus reactive maintenance activities.
   

  

**Occupant Services \& Experience**
 Act as first point of contact for occupant inquiries related to facility services. Coordinate special requests for events, meetings, and workplace activities. Manage meeting room bookings, setup requirements, and catering arrangements. Support workplace hospitality and visitor experience initiatives. Conduct occupant satisfaction surveys and implement feedback. Build positive relationships with building occupants and department representatives. Develop service improvement plans based on user feedback and emerging needs. Communicate planned maintenance activities and potential service disruptions proactively.
   

  

**Project Support \& Continuous Improvement**
 Assist with facility services transitions, vendor changes, and service improvements. Support office moves, workspace reconfigurations, and setup activities. Coordinate deep cleaning projects, carpet cleaning, and specialized services. Assist with facility events, corporate functions, and special programs. Support small capital projects and equipment upgrades. Participate in facility improvement initiatives and workplace enhancement projects. Identify inefficiencies and recommend process improvements. Benchmark services against industry standards and best practices. Lead or support service optimization initiatives. Implement lessons learned and best practices from completed projects.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
**Education:** 
 Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Facility Management, Engineering Technology, Building Services, Business Administration, or related field. High school diploma with relevant technical and facility services experience may be considered.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5\-7 years of experience in integrated facility services, combining soft services coordination with technical services support. Experience in commercial office buildings, corporate facilities, industrial sites, or multi\-tenant environments. Background in vendor coordination, service delivery operations, and performance monitoring. Demonstrated experience with governance, compliance monitoring, or quality assurance. Exposure to building systems maintenance and work order management. Customer service experience in a corporate or professional environment. Experience managing service level agreements and performance metrics.
   

  

**Technical Knowledge:** 
 Understanding of housekeeping operations, cleaning standards, and industry best practices. Familiarity with workplace services including reception, mail services, and amenity management. Basic technical knowledge of building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and lighting. Understanding of preventive maintenance principles and equipment servicing requirements. Ability to interpret basic technical documentation, service reports, and maintenance logs. Knowledge of governance frameworks, SOP development, and quality management systems. Understanding of KPI development, performance monitoring, and reporting methodologies. Knowledge of health and safety requirements for facility and technical services. Proficiency with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) or CAFM platforms. Knowledge of inventory management and supplies coordination. Understanding of building automation systems and energy management concepts preferred.
   

  

**Governance \& Compliance Skills:** 
 Ability to develop and implement standard operating procedures and service standards. Experience conducting audits, inspections, and quality assessments. Strong documentation and record\-keeping capabilities. Understanding of compliance requirements and regulatory frameworks. Knowledge of vendor management best practices and contract administration. Familiarity with performance measurement and continuous improvement methodologies. Experience with reporting tools and dashboard creation. Understanding of statutory compliance requirements for building systems.
   

  

**Skills:** 
 Strong organizational and multitasking abilities with exceptional attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills across all organizational levels. Customer service orientation with analytical and problem\-solving mindset. Ability to coordinate multiple vendors and service providers simultaneously. Technical aptitude with ability to understand basic building systems and maintenance requirements. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint), particularly Excel for data analysis and reporting. Report writing and documentation skills with ability to present findings clearly. Data analysis capabilities to identify trends and insights from performance metrics. Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively. Professional demeanor and presentation skills. Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and urgent requests. Process\-oriented thinking with focus on standardization and efficiency. Basic troubleshooting and problem diagnosis abilities.
   

  

 Personal Attributes
   

  

 Strong attention to detail and quality consciousness. Proactive approach with ability to anticipate needs and identify issues before escalation. Professional and courteous demeanor with all stakeholders. Team player with collaborative working style. Resilient and calm under pressure with strong problem\-solving abilities. Service\-minded with commitment to excellence and continuous improvement. Reliable and trustworthy with strong work ethic and integrity. Adaptable to changing environments and requirements. Analytical mindset with ability to translate data into actionable insights. Process\-driven with focus on standardization and best practices. Technical curiosity and willingness to learn about building systems. Decisive with ability to prioritize competing demands effectively.
   

  

 Working Conditions
   

  

 Standard business hours Monday to Saturday, with flexibility for early morning or evening service coordination. On\-call availability may be required for emergency technical or service issues. Occasional weekend work may be required for special events, audits, projects, or emergency response. Office\-based with significant time spent conducting facility inspections, vendor coordination, and documentation. Fast\-paced environment with multiple concurrent priorities requiring effective time management. Interaction with diverse stakeholders including occupants, vendors, management, technical contractors, and external auditors. May require flexibility for urgent service issues, technical emergencies, compliance matters, or occupant needs. Regular use of computers for documentation, reporting, and analysis. Exposure to mechanical rooms, plant areas, and technical environments.
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators
   

  

 Occupant satisfaction scores and feedback ratings. Service delivery compliance and quality audit results. Vendor performance ratings and SLA adherence metrics. Response time to service requests and issue resolution rates. Cleanliness and presentation standards maintenance scores. Technical service response times and first\-time fix rates. Equipment uptime and preventive maintenance completion rates. Cost management within assigned budget parameters. Incident reporting accuracy and safety compliance metrics. Completion rates for inspections, audits, and quality checks. Timeliness and accuracy of performance reports and documentation. Number of process improvements implemented. Governance compliance rates and audit findings. Non\-conformance identification and resolution rates. Work order completion rates and backlog management. Energy consumption trends and efficiency improvements.
   

  

 Reporting Structure
   

  

 Reports to: Facility Manager, Operations Manager, or Integrated Facilities Manager
   

  

 Interfaces with: Building occupants, department heads, technical vendors, soft services contractors, security teams, reception staff, housekeeping supervisors, maintenance technicians, facility management team, procurement, finance, health \& safety personnel, engineering consultants, and compliance auditors.

title: EHS Executive
description:
**About us** 




  





 Umendra Life Sciences manufactures OTC topical pharmaceuticals and personal care products — creams, gels, lotions and ointments — primarily for the US and other international markets.
 



  





 We are looking to add an EHS Executive to our team.
 



  





**The role** 




 You will own day\-to\-day Environment, Health and Safety at the site — the shop floor version, not the head\-office version. That means being visibly present in operational areas, knowing the high\-risk jobs before they start, and having the standing to intervene when something isn't right. You'll work alongside production, maintenance, projects, HR and contractors.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Run the daily inspection rhythm — identify unsafe acts and conditions, drive corrective action to closure, and stay on it until it's closed.
* Own the permit\-to\-work system end\-to\-end: hot work, work at height, confined\-space entry, electrical isolation and other high\-risk activities.
* Lead risk assessments, Job Safety Analyses and toolbox talks so that hazard thinking sits with the line, not only with you.
* Investigate incidents, near misses and environmental events — root cause, CAPA, and verification that the fix held.
* Own emergency preparedness: response plans plus fire, evacuation, spill\-response and first\-aid drills that people actually take seriously.
* Deliver induction, refresher and contractor safety training, and hold contractors to the same standard as employees — from prequalification through on\-site supervision.
* Keep statutory compliance clean: registers, inspection records, testing and certification schedules, and direct interaction with regulators and external auditors.
* Manage environmental controls — waste segregation, hazardous\-waste handling, emissions, effluent, and energy and resource use.
* Drive implementation and continual improvement of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 at the site.
* Report what matters — weekly and monthly EHS dashboards, trend analysis and honest escalation to management.
* Build participation: safety observations, campaigns, suggestions and committee meetings that generate real input from the floor.



**Who fits** 




 Requirements, not preferences:
 


* Based at or willing to relocate to Ahmedabad, and able to work on\-site at our Bavla plant daily. This is a plant role — there is no remote or hybrid arrangement.
* 3–5 years of hands\-on EHS experience in manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, engineering or construction. Plant floor exposure is essential; corporate or consulting\-only backgrounds won't translate.
* Recognized Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety, meeting applicable statutory requirements, alongside a Bachelor's degree or diploma in Engineering, Science, Environmental Studies or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of Indian occupational safety, fire, environmental and waste\-management regulations.
* Direct experience running incident investigations, risk assessments, permit\-to\-work systems and emergency response.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, Hindi and Gujarati — you'll be explaining the same standard to a plant head and to a contract worker on the same day.



 Preferred: ISO 45001 / ISO 14001 internal auditor certification. First\-aid and fire\-safety certification. Pharmaceutical, cosmetic or chemical manufacturing background.
 



  





 What we're really looking for is judgment and persistence — the confidence to interrupt work that's unsafe, the credibility to be listened to when you do, and the patience to chase a corrective action until it's genuinely closed rather than merely logged.
 



**What this role is not** 



* Not a corporate or head\-office EHS position — you will spend most of your day in operational areas, not at a desk.
* Not remote or hybrid.
* Not a documentation\-only role. Records matter, but a candidate whose experience is limited to maintaining files and preparing audit paperwork will struggle here.
* Not a role where safety gets overruled by schedule pressure.



**How you'll be measured** 




 Recordable incidents and lost\-time injuries. Near\-miss reporting rates — we want these going up, not down. Closure rate and ageing of corrective actions. Completion of inspections, audits, training and drills. Contractor and permit compliance. Zero overdue statutory renewals. Reduction in repeat findings.

title: Procurement Representative
description:

With the purpose of enhancing the quality of life in a material way, Eastman works with customers to deliver innovative products and solutions while maintaining a commitment to safety and sustainability. The company’s innovation\-driven growth model takes advantage of world\-class technology platforms, deep customer engagement, and differentiated application development to grow its leading positions in attractive end markets such as transportation, building and construction, and consumables. **Role Description**
 Eastman is driven by a purpose to enhance the quality of life in a material way and a vision to be the world's leading material innovation company. Our long history of technical expertise in chemical processes and polymer science positions us to provide innovative solutions to some of the world's most complex problems.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Responsible for procurement of assigned information technology products, software, SaaS subscriptions, cloud services, telecommunications, hardware, and IT professional services while utilizing market intelligence and negotiation strategies to achieve the best value for Eastman.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Develop and maintain accurate
 **Building Information Models (BIM)**

 **3D BIM models**

 **MEP, structural, and other disciplines** 
 .

* Ensure BIM models are developed according to project BIM standards and workflows.

* Support the team in producing drawings and documentation for design development and construction.
* Assist in improving BIM workflows, standards, and project delivery processes.



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in
 **Architecture / Architectural Engineering** 
 or a related field.
