title: Cyber Engineer
description:
**Job Title**
 Cyber Security Platform Engineer
   

  

**Location**
 India (Pune)
   

  

**Reports to**
 Cyber Security Engineering Lead (India) with functional alignment to Head of Cyber Platform Engineering
   

  

****Role Overview****
 FNZ is building a global Cyber Platform Engineering function responsible for the operation, reliability, and evolution of the firm’s core security platforms.
   

  

 We are seeking a Cyber Security Platform Engineer to join the growing engineering capability in India. This is a hands\-on technical role focused on operating and improving FNZ’s production cyber security platforms.
   

  

 The successful candidate will help ensure FNZ’s security platforms remain reliable, well\-configured, and continuously improving through engineering, automation, and operational excellence.
   

  

 This role sits within Cyber Platform Engineering, not the Security Operations Centre (SOC). The focus is on engineering and operating security platforms, rather than monitoring alerts or performing SOC analysis.
   

  

 You will work closely with global engineering teams across the UK, US, and APAC.
   

  

****Core Responsibilities****
 Operate, maintain, and continuously improve FNZ’s production security platforms to ensure reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The role combines hands\-on platform operation with engineering improvements that enhance platform capability and reduce operational overhead.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include:**
* Configuring, operating, and optimising enterprise security platforms
* Supporting platform upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management
* Monitoring platform health, reliability, and performance
* Troubleshooting operational issues across security platforms
* Ensuring platforms operate in line with FNZ’s global security and operational standards
* Assisting with automation of platform configuration and operational workflows
* Supporting integrations between security platforms and internal systems
* Writing scripts or tooling to improve operational efficiency
* Supporting infrastructure automation or configuration improvements
* Helping improve telemetry pipelines and data flows between security platforms


 Engineers are expected to approach platform operations with an engineering mindset
 **,** 
 identifying opportunities to improve automation, reliability, and operational efficiency over time
   

  

 Incident Engineering Support
   

  

 Provide engineering support during security incidents where platform expertise is required.
   

  

**This Includes:**
* Supporting incident response teams with platform troubleshooting
* Assisting with root\-cause analysis
* Helping implement fixes and improvements following incidents


 The focus is platform engineering support, not incident monitoring or SOC investigation.
   

  

 Platform Reliability \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

 Work with the wider engineering team to improve the maturity and reliability of FNZ’s security platform environment.
   

  

**This Includes:**
* Identifying recurring operational issues
* Contributing to automation initiatives
* Improving platform observability and operational metrics
* Supporting adoption of new security tools and platform capabilities


 Working Pattern
   

  

 The team provides global coverage across shifts aligned with international operations.
   

  

 Core hours will align with APAC and EMEA collaboration, with occasional out\-of\-hours work required during major incidents or platform maintenance windows.
   

  

****Required Experience****
 Candidates should demonstrate hands\-on experience operating enterprise security platforms.
   

  

**Typical Background Includes:**
* 3–6 years in cyber security engineering or platform engineering roles
* Hands\-on experience working with enterprise security platforms
* Experience troubleshooting operational issues across security controls
* Experience working within distributed global engineering teams


 Technical Experience
   

  

 Experience across several of the following security platform domains is expected:
   

  

* Endpoint security platforms (EDR / XDR) such as CrowdStrike, Defender, SentinelOne
* Secure Web Gateway / Proxy platforms such as Netskope, Zscaler, iBoss, Prisma Access
* Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and application\-layer protection platforms
* Security logging and SIEM platforms
* Email security platforms and secure email gateways
* Vulnerability management platforms
* Network security controls, including next\-generation firewalls


 Candidates should demonstrate experience operating, configuring, and supporting these platforms in production environments.
   

  

 Engineering \& Automation Experience
   

  

**Experience In The Following Areas Is Beneficial:**
* scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar)
* working with APIs for platform integrations
* infrastructure automation or configuration management
* operating security tooling in cloud environments


 Nice to Have
   

  

**Experience In The Following Areas Would Be Beneficial:**
* infrastructure\-as\-code or DevOps practices
* cloud security platform engineering
* integrating security tooling within CI/CD pipelines
* platform telemetry and observability tooling


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will:**
* support the reliable operation of FNZ’s security platforms
* contribute to engineering improvements and automation initiatives
* help maintain platform performance and stability
* collaborate effectively with global engineering teams
* grow technical expertise across FNZ’s security platform ecosystem


 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 Security platforms form a critical part of FNZ’s global technology infrastructure.
   

  

**The Cyber Platform Engineering Team Ensures These Platforms Remain:**
* reliable
* scalable
* well\-engineered
* continuously improving


 This role contributes directly to maintaining the security and resilience of FNZ’s global environment.
   

  

***About FNZ***
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end\-to\-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2\.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
   

  

 Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

 Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.

 As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:

 As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day\-to\-day work will include:

* Work within a ticket\-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution

 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform.  Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

 Website
 **Trading Technologies**
 Multi\-asset platform for capital markets
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Security Control Assessment Specialist to independently test the design and operating effectiveness of Trading Technologies’ enterprise cybersecurity controls. This role plans and executes control assessments end to end, documents findings with clear supporting evidence, and partners with control owners and the TT Security team to design practical remediations. The role also contributes to the continuous improvement of the control environment itself, strengthening how controls are defined, evidenced and monitored, and automating control testing where possible.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Plan and execute independent tests of enterprise cybersecurity controls across TT’s technology estate, with a high degree of autonomy over scoping, methodology, sampling and scheduling.
* Assess both the design and the operating effectiveness of controls, combining evidence review and control owner walkthroughs with hands\-on technical validation of configurations, logs, identity and access data, and cloud environments.
* Document findings clearly and defensibly, setting out the condition, criteria, cause, risk and impact, and rating them consistently against TT’s risk criteria.
* Partner with control owners and TT Security to design workable remediations, then validate closure through retesting rather than accepting assertion alone.
* Track findings and remediation plans through to closure, escalating overdue or inadequately addressed items where necessary.
* Build and maintain automated and continuous control monitoring so that control health is visible between formal assessment cycles.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the control framework itself, refining control definitions, testing procedures, evidence requirements and the annual assessment plan.
* Map the control environment to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIST frameworks, identifying gaps, duplication and opportunities to test once and satisfy multiple obligations.
* Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and control owners, setting expectations, communicating requirements clearly, and holding a firm, evidence\-based position when findings are challenged.
* Support external audits and customer assessments by providing tested, reliable control evidence.


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* 8 to 10 years of IT experience, including at least 5 years focused on information security.
* Professional certification required: CISM, CISSP, CISA, CRISC or equivalent.
* Demonstrable experience designing and executing security control tests and producing findings and workpapers that withstand audit scrutiny.
* Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity controls and frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and NIST SP 800\-53\.
* Technical depth across identity and access management, cloud infrastructure (AWS certification is a plus), endpoint and network security, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management and secure development practices.
* Experience automating control testing or building continuous control monitoring, using scripting, queries, APIs or GRC platform automation.
* Familiarity with GRC platforms such as OneTrust, Vanta, Drata, ServiceNow IRM or similar.
* Exceptional spoken and written English, with the ability to explain technical requirements and findings clearly to both engineers and senior stakeholders.
* Confidence and diplomacy to challenge control owners constructively and to hold a position under pressure when the evidence supports it.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage a portfolio of concurrent assessments and deliver to deadline with minimal supervision.

 Trading Technologies (www.tradingtechnologies.com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market\-leading technology for the end\-to\-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi\-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. description:

 Website

 Multi\-asset platform for capital markets
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Security Control Assessment Specialist to independently test the design and operating effectiveness of Trading Technologies’ enterprise cybersecurity controls. This role plans and executes control assessments end to end, documents findings with clear supporting evidence, and partners with control owners and the TT Security team to design practical remediations. The role also contributes to the continuous improvement of the control environment itself, strengthening how controls are defined, evidenced and monitored, and automating control testing where possible.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Plan and execute independent tests of enterprise cybersecurity controls across TT’s technology estate, with a high degree of autonomy over scoping, methodology, sampling and scheduling.
* Assess both the design and the operating effectiveness of controls, combining evidence review and control owner walkthroughs with hands\-on technical validation of configurations, logs, identity and access data, and cloud environments.
* Document findings clearly and defensibly, setting out the condition, criteria, cause, risk and impact, and rating them consistently against TT’s risk criteria.
* Partner with control owners and TT Security to design workable remediations, then validate closure through retesting rather than accepting assertion alone.
* Track findings and remediation plans through to closure, escalating overdue or inadequately addressed items where necessary.
* Build and maintain automated and continuous control monitoring so that control health is visible between formal assessment cycles.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the control framework itself, refining control definitions, testing procedures, evidence requirements and the annual assessment plan.
* Map the control environment to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIST frameworks, identifying gaps, duplication and opportunities to test once and satisfy multiple obligations.
* Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and control owners, setting expectations, communicating requirements clearly, and holding a firm, evidence\-based position when findings are challenged.
* Support external audits and customer assessments by providing tested, reliable control evidence.


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* 8 to 10 years of IT experience, including at least 5 years focused on information security.
* Professional certification required: CISM, CISSP, CISA, CRISC or equivalent.
* Demonstrable experience designing and executing security control tests and producing findings and workpapers that withstand audit scrutiny.
* Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity controls and frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and NIST SP 800\-53\.
* Technical depth across identity and access management, cloud infrastructure (AWS certification is a plus), endpoint and network security, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management and secure development practices.
* Experience automating control testing or building continuous control monitoring, using scripting, queries, APIs or GRC platform automation.
* Familiarity with GRC platforms such as OneTrust, Vanta, Drata, ServiceNow IRM or similar.
* Exceptional spoken and written English, with the ability to explain technical requirements and findings clearly to both engineers and senior stakeholders.
* Confidence and diplomacy to challenge control owners constructively and to hold a position under pressure when the evidence supports it.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage a portfolio of concurrent assessments and deliver to deadline with minimal supervision.
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.


**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Experience in financial services, capital markets or another regulated industry is highly regarded.

title: Youtube Channel Manager
description:
**YouTube Channel Manager** 




 Location: Mumbai / Chennai (On\-site)
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a high\-ownership YouTube Channel Lead to build and scale our YouTube channel into a meaningful audience and acquisition engine.
 



 The role will own the channel end to end: strategy, audience growth, content direction, acquisition, performance and the operating engine behind it. The ideal candidate understands both the creative and growth sides of YouTube and can turn audience insights into content that people want to watch, share and return to.
 



 Prior experience building or scaling a YouTube channel, preferably to 100,000\+ subscribers, is strongly preferred.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own Channel Strategy and Growth
* Define the audience, content pillars, formats, publishing cadence and growth roadmap for the channel.
* Own Audience Acquisition
* Build and execute strategies to acquire new viewers and convert them into subscribers across YouTube discovery, Shorts, search, recommendations, collaborations, social distribution and other relevant channels.
* Drive Content Strategy
* Own the content pipeline across long\-form and short\-form. Identify high\-potential topics, formats and recurring series using audience behaviour, category trends, competitor analysis and channel performance.
* Shape Content Development
* Work closely with researchers, writers and creators to sharpen ideas, narratives, hooks and talking points. Ensure every video has a clear audience proposition and strong reason to watch.
* Drive Packaging
* Own the thinking behind titles, thumbnails and video positioning. Work with creative teams to improve click\-through and audience engagement while maintaining quality and trust.
* Own Performance and Analytics
* Track views, watch time, retention, subscribers, click\-through rates and other key metrics. Translate performance into clear decisions on what to make, improve or stop.
* Build the Content Engine
* Create the systems and operating rhythm required to consistently produce high\-quality content at scale. Coordinate closely with researchers, writers, editors, designers and on\-screen talent.
* Experiment and Scale What Works
* Continuously test topics, formats, hooks, packaging and distribution. Identify winning patterns and turn them into repeatable growth levers.
* Build a Long\-Term Channel Brand
* Develop a distinctive point of view and strong audience relationship while balancing short\-term performance with long\-term credibility and brand building.



  





**Requirements** 



* 5 to 8 years of experience in YouTube, digital content, media, audience growth or related roles
* Proven experience building or scaling YouTube channels
* Experience with a 100,000\+ subscriber channel is preferred
* Strong understanding of YouTube discovery, recommendations, retention and subscriber growth
* Ability to combine content judgement with data\-led growth thinking
* Strong understanding of both long\-form and short\-form content
* Strong writing, communication and stakeholder management skills
* High ownership and ability to work independently in a fast\-moving environment



 Nice to Have
 


* Experience in finance, fintech, business or educational content
* Experience taking a channel from an early stage to meaningful scale
* Experience with creator collaborations and cross\-platform distribution
* Strong understanding of YouTube SEO and discovery
* Experience building recurring shows or content franchises
* Ability to contribute directly to research, scripting or content development

title: Campus Representative
description:
**Company Description** 
 Harvique Consulting helps individuals and businesses move forward with clarity, confidence, and practical solutions. The company supports professionals in building stronger career profiles through tailored resume writing, cover letters, and LinkedIn optimization so they can stand out in competitive markets. Harvique is also expanding into business support services, including growth and marketing, customer support, freelancing support, analytics, reporting, and operational solutions. The team focuses on turning challenges into progress by improving both career trajectories and business performance through smarter operations and better results.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Campus Representative is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Delhi, India. This role involves promoting Harvique’s services on campus, organizing information sessions and events, and acting as a primary point of contact between students and Harvique Consulting. The Campus Representative will engage with student groups, faculty, and campus organizations to build awareness of Harvique’s career and business support offerings. Daily tasks include networking with students, conducting presentations, gathering feedback, supporting marketing campaigns, and contributing ideas to enhance outreach and engagement. The role also includes reporting campus activities, sharing insights on student needs, and collaborating with the Harvique team to refine campus strategies.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Presentations skills to effectively convey Harvique’s value to diverse campus audiences.
* Candidates should possess Event Planning skills to organize workshops, information sessions, and promotional activities on campus.
* Candidates should possess Sales and Networking skills to generate interest, build relationships, and encourage student participation in Harvique’s services.
* Candidates should demonstrate initiative, reliability, and the ability to work independently while coordinating with remote teams.
* Candidates should have familiarity with social media and basic marketing practices to support campus campaigns.
* Prior experience in student leadership, campus clubs, or ambassador roles is beneficial.
* Currently enrolled students or recent graduates from institutions in Delhi, India are preferred.
